title: Implement retry logic for GitHub App token requests to handle transient errors
summary: GetGitHubAppAuthToken now retries transient failures on GitHub API requests for retrieving installation tokens, using three attempts with 5 and 10 second waits to handle intermittent errors.
key_points: GET and POST requests in GetGitHubAppAuthToken are wrapped with retry logic
Retries use same settings as other GitHub API calls: 3 attempts with 5 and 10 second delays
JWT token validity and short-lived token creation make retrying safe
Pester unit tests cover 404 on installation lookup, 502 on token request, and repeated failures
All actions using GitHub App authentication benefit, not just CheckForUpdates
